{"code": "from werkzeug.routing import Map, Rule

# Define URL rules with endpoints

    Rule('/', endpoint='index'),
    Rule('/downloads/', endpoint='downloads/index'),
    Rule('/downloads/<int:id>', endpoint='downloads/show')
]

# Create a URL map
url_map = Map(url_rules)

# Bind the map to the server name and path
adapter = url_map.bind('example.com', '/')

result = adapter.match('/downloads/123', method='GET')

result"}
